# Juy.ai Website

> Juy.ai is a comprehensive AI-powered image enhancement platform offering professional-grade tools for image upscaling, restoration, colorization, and creative generation. Our services help photographers, designers, businesses, and individuals transform their images with cutting-edge AI technology, supporting multiple languages and providing instant results.

Key Services:
- AI Image Upscaler: Enhance resolution up to 4x without quality loss
- Photo Restoration: Repair and restore old, damaged, or low-quality photos
- Face Enhancement: Specialized AI for improving portrait quality and clarity
- Photo Colorization: Transform black & white photos into vibrant color images
- Background Removal: Create transparent backgrounds with precision
- Anime Image Processing: Specialized tools for anime and cartoon-style images
- AI Image Generation: Create new images using advanced AI models (Flux, Google Imagen 4)

Available in 5 languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian.

## AI Image Enhancement Services

- [AI Image Upscaler](https://juy.ai/ai-image-upscaler-online): Professional image upscaling up to 4x resolution with no quality loss
- [Anime Image Upscaler](https://juy.ai/anime-image-upscaler-online-free): Specialized upscaling for anime, manga, and cartoon-style images
- [Face Photo Restoration](https://juy.ai/restore-any-face-photo): AI-powered face enhancement and portrait restoration
- [Old Photo Restoration](https://juy.ai/old-photo-restoration): Repair vintage photos, remove scratches, and restore clarity
- [Photo Colorization](https://juy.ai/colorize-photo): Add realistic colors to black & white photographs
- [Background Removal](https://juy.ai/transparent-background-maker-free): Professional background removal for product photos and portraits

## AI Image Generation Tools

- [Flux Kontext Pro](https://juy.ai/flux-kontext-pro): Advanced AI image generation with superior context understanding
- [Flux Schnell](https://juy.ai/flux-schnell): Fast, high-quality AI image generation
- [Free Flux 1.1 Pro](https://juy.ai/free-flux-1-1-pro): Enhanced Flux model with professional-grade features
- [Google Imagen 4](https://juy.ai/google-imagen-4): Google's latest AI image generation technology
- [Realistic AI Image Generator](https://juy.ai/realistic-ai-image-generator): Create photorealistic images from text descriptions

## Specialized Tools

- [4K Anime Upscaling](https://juy.ai/upscale-anime-image-to-4k): Ultra-high resolution enhancement for anime artwork
- [1.5x Image Upscaling](https://juy.ai/upscale-image-1-5x-online): Gentle resolution enhancement for various image types

## Pricing & Plans

All services offer:
- Free tier with 30 credits to start
- Basic plan ($10/month) with 500 credits and priority processing
- Pro plan ($30/month) with 2000 credits and advanced features
- No software installation required - everything works in your browser
- Support for common image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF)

## Use Cases

- **Photographers**: Enhance print resolution and restore old client photos
- **eCommerce**: Improve product photo quality for online stores
- **Social Media**: Create high-quality content for platforms
- **Designers**: Upscale low-resolution assets for professional projects
- **Personal**: Restore family photos and enhance personal memories
- **Content Creators**: Generate and enhance images for digital content
